title: Berserk
description: Kentaro Miura's towering dark fantasy opus chronicling Guts, the Black Swordsman, wielding the Dragonslayer in defiance of causality and demonic Apostles.

title: Vagabond
description: Takehiko Inoue's brush-ink retelling of legendary sword saint Miyamoto Musashi's philosophical quest to become invincible under the sun.

title: Chainsaw Man Part 1 & 2
description: Tatsuki Fujimoto's cinematic punk manga blending visceral devil eviscerations with raw emotional intimacy and tragic subversion of heroic tropes.

title: Monster
description: Naoki Urasawa's masterclass in suspense tracking neurosurgeon Kenzo Tenma across reunited Germany as he hunts the charismatic monster Johan Liebert.

title: Tokyo Ghoul & Tokyo Ghoul:re
description: Sui Ishida's tragic psychological metamorphosis of Ken Kaneki, exploring Kafkaesque biological alienation and the tragedy of coexistence.

title: 20th Century Boys
description: Childhood friends reunite in adulthood when their childhood imaginary apocalypse 'Book of Prophecy' begins taking place in real-world Tokyo under a cult leader called Friend.

title: Vinland Saga
description: Makoto Yukimura's journey of Thorfinn from bloodthirsty teenage Viking revenger to pacifist explorer seeking a land free from war and slavery.

title: Uzumaki
description: Junji Ito's psychological nightmare concerning the fogbound town of Kurouzu-cho, slowly infected and deformed by the supernatural curse of the spiral.

title: Goodnight Punpun
description: Inio Asano's devastating coming-of-age portrait of Onodera Punpun, drawn as a caricatured bird as his real-world adolescent innocence crumbles.

title: One Piece
description: Eiichiro Oda's record-breaking serialized pirate epic, tracking Monkey D. Luffy across the Grand Line in the world's most intricate worldbuilding saga.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
description: Hiromu Arakawa's flawlessly structured adventure of the Elric brothers, exploring the scientific horrors of warfare, human sacrifice, and equivalent exchange.

title: Dandadan
description: Yukinobu Tatsu's chaotic kinetic hit pairing an occult believer and an alien fanatic in supersonic battles against urban yokai and extraterrestrials.
